newsitem.title: CHINA: City Telecom dives on trading debut.
newsitem.headline: City Telecom dives on trading debut.

text.p: Shares of telecommunication services provider City Telecom (HK) Ltd ended their first day of trading at HK$1.68 each, below their issue price of HK$1.80.
The company shares moved in a range of HK$1.62 to HK$1.85.
Volume was 38.85 million shares worth HK$65.47 million.

"A weak debut was expected in view of its weak flotation response, and the shares failure to hold above their issue price further disappointed investors," said Kinson Au, research manager at Asia Financial Securities.
City Telecom, a long-distance callback operator, offered 100 million shares at HK$1.80 each in a public offering in Hong Kong and was 2.85 times subscribed.
Analysts said concern over fierce market competition in the industry and the company's lack of a clear plan to exploit the growing Chinese market had made the issue unexciting.
"People are still concerned very much on the fierce market competition and that can dampen investors interest on the issue in the medium run," Au said.
City Telecom had said it would use the net proceeds raised from the issue to build switching centres in Hong Kong and Japan, for development of new services and for working capital.
